summary: Retest of iteration_15 fixes. All 6 requested items verified as fixed. Backend: new suite test_iteration16_retest.py 6/7 pass (the one failure is an extra edge case: a slab scheme_detail whose slabs are not a list of objects returns 500). Regression: test_iteration15_retail 20/20 and iteration14_mapping + client_features 65/65 pass. Frontend at 390x844 as demo@rxtech.com: the /search distributor chip no longer overlaps the scan button and opens the picker when tapped. The /returns Bill number input ends at x=374, inside the 390px screen. On Vendors the floating chat button (y=712) does not cover any Map/Unmap button at the bottom of the Mapped or Unmapped tab. Unmapping dist-1 (₹1,35,867 outstanding) shows only the 'Can't unmap yet' toast with no confirm dialog. On /disputes, legacy resolved DSP-82214 (no flagged field) shows 'Confirm & Unflag' and unflagging it works (status is now closed, flagged=false). No deprecated Expo packages found in the files reviewed.

minor.issue: scheme_detail {type:'slab', slabs:'abc'} or slabs:['x'] returns 500 (AttributeError: x.get on a non-dict) instead of 400. All requested cases return 400: missing pct/amount/buy, pct out of range, empty/missing slabs, slab missing buy/free, empty custom text.

credit_used is -150, shown in Vendors as 'Credit ₹-150 / ₹1.0L'. Likely cause: the short-supply refund in server.py ~line 2189 and the return-credit path ~line 2257 use $inc without clamping at 0, unlike _adjust_credit which uses max(0, ...).

The customer check accepts any mappings document, including pending or rejected ones. A distributor can rate a pharmacy that only sent a request or was rejected. Consider filtering to status 'mapped' or 'unmapped', or requiring an order.

issues: Open legacy queries without a flagged field (e.g. DSP-72588) show 'FLAGGED' with no 🚩 icon, while new ones show '🚩 FLAGGED'. Use d.flagged !== false for the icon too.
'Confirm & Unflag' closes the ticket in one tap with no confirmation step, although the label suggests one.
The search input is about 142px wide at 390px, so the placeholder 'Search medicine, salt…' is cut off. Cosmetic only.

action_items: In the PATCH inventory scheme validation, check that slabs is a list of dicts. Also catch AttributeError, or validate scheme_detail with a Pydantic model, so malformed slabs return 400.
Clamp credit_used at 0 in the short-supply refund and return/credit-note $inc paths. Fix the existing negative value for demo dist-3.
Optional: limit distributor rating to pharmacies with mapping status 'mapped' or 'unmapped', or with an order. Show the 🚩 icon whenever d.flagged !== false.
critical_code_review_comments: retail_features.py dist_unmap allows a distributor to unmap a pharmacy with outstanding credit. credit_used is kept and GET /distributors/{id} shows credit_limit 0 with credit_used intact, as intended, and credit orders are then blocked (400).
request_mapping allows role None or 'pharmacist'. Owner and manager now get 403 (verified).

success_rate.backend: 96% (26/27 in targeted suites; the 1 failure is an extra edge case) plus 65/65 regression
